title: Development of an environmentally friendly halogen-free phosphorus-nitrogen bond flame retardant for cotton fabrics
treatment_method: Immerse overnight at room temperature in CN-3 formulation in 30% aqueous isopropanol; pad at 10 psi; dry at 100 C for 5 min; cure in air at 160 C for 5 min.
onset_definition: Author-reported onset of degradation; no percentage-loss definition. Higher add-ons have two onset stages; not DTG peaks.
TG_locator: Table 3, p 1558: nitrogen TG, onset of degradation and char at 600 C; Figure 5 uses first onset for higher add-ons.
LOI_locator: Table 4, p 1560: exact average LOI, standard deviation [s] and replicate count.
conditions_locator: Measurements and Fabric treatment, p 1556; Thermal properties, p 1557 explicitly assigns Table 3 to nitrogen.
pairing_evidence: Tables 1, 3 and 4 identify the same fabric construction and exact after-cure CN-3 add-on. Initial unwashed material is used; separate 40 C durability washing/add-on retention is not mapped onto these TG observations.
source_location: Original author-uploaded article fulltext pp 1555-1563; methods p 1556 and Tables 1/3/4.
limitations: Original author-uploaded full article text reviewed; PDF download failed and no pixel review is claimed. Exact Table 4 means and standard deviations are retained; prose reports integer-rounded LOI summaries (23.7 to 24, 28.6 to 29, 27.6 to 28). The control print-cloth LOI conflicts between abstract 18 and conclusion 12 and is excluded. Table 3 is nitrogen only despite methods also mentioning air. Multiple onsets are author-defined onset stages, not T5/T10 or Tmax. Separate durability-washed samples and neat CN-3 additive are excluded. TG aliquot geometry and mass are not reported.
